footer.ready_to_start: Ready to eliminate context pollution? Let's get you started.

home.title: Prism Context Engine
home.tagline: The Context Operating System for Vibecoders
home.description: Eliminate "Context Pollution" by orchestrating the flow of rules, design systems, and tech stacks between the Cloud and local AI Agents.
home.prism_description: Prism Context Engine is a complete AI-powered context governance platform that:
home.feature_1: Extracts Rules from Video - Upload screen recordings, automatically extract architectural patterns using Azure OpenAI
home.feature_2: Enforces Standards - Deploy rules to AI coding assistants via MCP (Model Context Protocol)
home.feature_3: Enables Semantic Search - Find relevant architectural discussions using vector embeddings
home.video_first_desc: Record your screen while discussing architecture. Prism automatically extracts rules from your explanations.
home.ai_powered_desc: GPT-4o-mini analyzes transcripts to identify architectural patterns, code style conventions, naming rules, testing strategies, and security practices.
home.semantic_search_desc: Vector embeddings enable finding relevant architectural discussions, not just keyword matching.
home.zero_config_desc: npx prism connect and you're done. Your AI assistant now has context.
